title: Hero Launch System
description: A five-image launch sequence that establishes one new hero and extends her identity across reveal poster, select crop, banner, and ability-marketing art.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the canonical heroine identity, silhouette, and palette. Images 02-05 preserve the same face, hair base, body proportions, costume logic, and faction color system while translating the hero into different promo surfaces.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-hero-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-splash-launch-poster, 03-character-select-bust, 04-victory-banner-pose, and 05-ability-showcase-triptych. Queue may run 02-05 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
